components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Neutral high-contrast action for the primary path.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 48px; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; background: #1c1917; color: #ffffff; padding: 12px 20px; font: 600 14px/1.25 Geist, Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #292524; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(190,18,60,0.3); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #0c0a09; }

components.name: Rose Choice
components.description: Warm member of a paired, high-priority choice.

components.name: Sky Choice
components.description: Cool member of a paired, high-priority choice.

components.name: Focal Card
components.description: A softly raised surface for one focused decision or task.
components.html:
Choose together

Pick the list that feels right, then compare names one at a time.
components.css: .ds-card { max-width: 480px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.8); border-radius: 22px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.85); color: #1c1917; padding: 32px; box-shadow: 0 30px 90px -42px rgba(77,48,38,0.5); font-family: Geist, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-card h2 { margin: 0; font: 400 30px/1.2 Fraunces, Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: -0.03em; } .ds-card p { margin: 8px 0 0; color: #57534e; line-height: 1.75; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Compact, quiet field for practical name entry.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-name">Add a name</label><input class="ds-input" id="ds-name" placeholder="Name" />

narrative.overview:
LeBabyName feels like making an important choice together in a calm, welcoming room. A warm cream canvas, softly tinted choices, generous editorial type, and plain controls keep the product playful without becoming childish. The interface is mobile-first and direct: one decision is visually dominant, supporting detail remains quiet, and monetization never competes with the naming task.

The visual system pairs expressive Fraunces headlines with practical Geist UI copy. White surfaces float gently over cream rather than forming a dense dashboard, while rose and sky tints distinguish choices without assigning rigid meaning beyond the current source list.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream foundations with translucent or white content surfaces.
Generous serif display type paired with compact, legible sans-serif controls.
Soft, deeply rounded containers and restrained warm shadows.
Rose for action and focus; rose and sky pastels for paired choices.
Mobile-first layouts with short paths and comfortable tap targets.

rules.name: The Cream Ground Rule
rules.body: Product flows and public editorial pages begin on the cream canvas; white is a surface, not the default page field.

rules.name: The Accent Restraint Rule
rules.body: Rose and sky clarify actions or paired choices. They do not become large decorative fields or compete simultaneously for attention.

rules.name: The Names Deserve Ceremony Rule
rules.body: Names, winners, and decision prompts use the serif voice; controls and explanations stay sans-serif.

rules.name: The Tight Display Rule
rules.body: Large serif text uses close tracking and compact leading, while body copy keeps generous leading for reading comfort.

rules.name: The One Decision Rule
rules.body: The active choice or primary action receives the strongest scale and contrast; navigation, advertising, and secondary actions remain visibly subordinate.

rules.name: The Soft Layer Rule
rules.body: Use shadow with translucency and quiet borders to separate a meaningful surface; do not shadow every container.

rules.name: The Nested Radius Rule
rules.body: Inner controls use a visibly smaller radius than the surface containing them.

dos: Do keep primary touch targets around 3rem high and preserve visible keyboard focus.
Do use cream as the page ground and white as a layered surface.
Do let Fraunces carry names, outcomes, and major headings while Geist carries UI and reading copy.
Do keep legal, consent, advertising, and monetization surfaces visually quieter than the active naming task.
Do reduce or remove animation when the user requests reduced motion.
donts: Don't turn rose and sky into rigid gender claims; they are soft paired accents for source-list choices.
Don't place heavy shadows on every card or divider.
Don't use display serif styling for dense controls, metadata, or long body copy.
Don't let ads, consent prompts, or legal navigation obscure or interrupt a duel.
Don't introduce hard offset shadows, sharp-cornered feature cards, or saturated full-page backgrounds into this soft visual system.
